title: UFO over Sonoma State College art event, predicted by Owens
place_text: Sonoma State College, Rohnert Park, California

tellings.quote: art department, about a hundred people, were out there with their cameras and videotape in December 1976 and a UFO appeared right over the campus uh about 3,000 ft above the campus.

plain: In December 1976, about a hundred people from the art department at Sonoma State College in California were outside with cameras and video gear when a UFO showed up roughly 3,000 feet above the campus, an appearance that, the story goes, a man named Ted Owens had predicted. Jeffrey Mishlove, a researcher of psychic phenomena, tells this on the show without naming who told him, mentions a man named Stephen Pleski, and says the sighting made the front page of the Berkeley Gazette and the Channel 9 evening news. If true, someone would have called a UFO sighting in advance.
